title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.375. In the first face of this coordinate system, draw a single loop and within this loop, draw a circle. Position the center of the circle at coordinates (0.0075, 0.0075) and set its radius to 0.0075. Scale the 2D sketch using a factor of 0.015 to achieve the desired dimensions. Apply the transformation from the coordinate system to convert the 2D sketch into a 3D object. Extrude the 2D sketch along the normal direction by 0.1875 units and then extrude it in the opposite direction by the same distance to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.015 units in length, 0.015 units in width, and 0.375 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
translation_vector = (0.0, 0.0, 0.375)
euler_angles = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

# Create the base sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0075, 0.0075).circle(0.0075)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical shape
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
cylinder = cylinder.translate(translation_vector).rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), euler_angles[0]) \
                       .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), euler_angles[1]) \
                       .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), euler_angles[2])

# Final model
r = cylinder

# Display the model

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0075, 0.0075)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0075)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)  # Extrude in both directions

# Translate the cylinder to the specified position
cylinder = cylinder.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.375))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the top face
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0075) \
     .threePointArc((0.00375, 0.00375), (0.0075, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.0075, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.01125, 0.00375), (0.015, 0.0075)) \
     .lineTo(0.015, 0.0075) \
     .threePointArc((0.01125, 0.01125), (0.0075, 0.015)) \
     .lineTo(0.0075, 0.015) \
     .threePointArc((0.00375, 0.01125), (0.0, 0.0075)) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the body
r = r.extrude(0.375)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
